limitations: DEVELOPMENT-ONLY spectrogram experiment. Publisher recording labels; no fresh independent assessment, event timing, range or field-reliability claim.

training.label_scope: Publisher recording presence; positive bags can contain negative windows
training.objective: Positive bag: softplus(-max window logit); negative bag: mean softplus(window logit); balanced class and equal recording mass
training.selection: Minimum balanced publisher-bag development loss, every 2 epochs, max 60 uniform contexts per file
